title: Agents panel: Launch Copilot coding agent tasks anywhere on GitHub
attributed_claim_summary: GitHub expanded ways to start and track delegated agent work through an agents panel.
evidence_or_event: Source-authored report or launch; no original measurements collected in this repository.
limitations: Interface reach does not measure task success, external reuse, or distinct agent users.
research_relevance: AI-era coding workflow -> secure functionality -> independent reuse -> lifetime cost; distinguish release availability from observed adoption.
practical_experiment: Record task starts, abandonments, accepted outputs and follow-up defects, not launches alone.
